description: This is a PHP source file implementing a class 'main_listener' which acts as an event subscriber within a phpBB extension related to Quick Title Edition (QTE). It defines event handlers for modifying forum and topic views, posting, and attribute management, integrating with the phpBB system and QTE module.

classes.name: main_listener
classes.description: Event subscriber class for handling various forum, topic, and post related events in phpBB, facilitating attribute display and management via QTE extension.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns a list of events and corresponding handler methods this class subscribes to.

methods.name: viewforum_assign_topic_attributes
methods.description: Handles modification of topic rows in viewforum, adding attribute display if topic_attr_id exists.

methods.name: viewforum_get_user_infos
methods.description: Retrieves user information related to topics in the list.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_title
methods.description: Modifies the page title based on topic attribute.

methods.name: viewtopic_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Assigns attribute display variables and retrieves attribute data for topics.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_apply
methods.description: Applies an attribute to a topic based on user request.

methods.name: posting_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Handles attribute selection during post creation/edit.

methods.name: posting_check_attribute
methods.description: Validates the attribute selection during posting.

methods.name: posting_submit_data
methods.description: Prepares post data with attribute info before submission.

methods.name: posting_save_attribute
methods.description: Saves the attribute data to the database upon post submission.
